requirements.requirement: Keep sewing supplies tidy - organized storage with compartments
requirements.evidence: 3-cell L-shaped base (piece:0,0,0, 0,1,0, 1,0,0) with 3 bins: two 2-compartment bins (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2) and one full bin (bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) providing 5 compartments total for separating notions

Placed tape measure (prop:6), tweezers as seam-ripper/scissor stand-in (prop:2), pen/marker for pattern marking (prop:1), and small hardware heaps representing buttons/beads (prop:3, prop:4, prop:5). No dedicated sewing-specific props exist in catalog; workshop/desk props used as closest analogues.

finish.summary: Built compact 3-cell sewing caddy with 2 divided bins (4 compartments) + 1 open bin for fabric/scraps, caps and joint bolts fitted. Dressed with tape measure, tweezers, pen and small compartment heaps to show buttons/notions organization.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
